_about: Forensic envelope review D-120, round 1 (26 Nov 2026): corrections to the elevation glass read by src.arch.elev_glazing that the drawing conventions do not let a rule detect. Axis = building mm along the elevation (X from grid 2, Y from grid A). Areas are measured on the elevation PDFs (1:250 vectors). 'add' spreads the area over the visible facade steps in the range (rooms found by the inward probe); 'exclude' sets the glass of the range to 0; 'to_storey' moves the glass of a double-height space read in the upper band to the storey of the room. 'below_ground' marks facade the elevation shows below the ground line: no glass and no exposed wall.
